description: List active fallow-ignore suppression markers grouped per file with line, kind, level, reason, and a stale cross-reference. Runs `fallow suppressions --format json` and returns the `kind: "suppression-inventory"` envelope verbatim (a `summary` roll-up plus `files[]`); a governance surface for distrusting a clean verdict by seeing what is suppressed, not a gate, so it always exits 0 even when suppressions exist. Scope with `workspace`, `changed_since` (the natural pull-request review scope), or repeated `file` entries. Read-only. It runs a full analysis to populate the inventory, so on large repos raise `FALLOW_TIMEOUT_SECS` above the default 120s if it times out.

allow_remote_extends.description:
Allow trusted HTTPS config `extends` for this request. Defaults to false
and never grants process-global trust.

changed_since.description:
Git ref (e.g. "main", "HEAD~5"). Scopes the inventory to files changed
since the ref, the natural pull-request review scope.

config.description: Path to a fallow config file.

file.description:
Only list suppressions in these files. Relative paths resolve against the
project root; forwarded as a repeated `--file` flag.

max_output_bytes.description:
Byte cap for this call's response. Lowers the server cap (default
1000000); over it the call is REFUSED (`isError`, `exit_code: 2`).

production.description: Only analyze production code (excludes tests, stories, dev files).

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

threads.description: Parser thread count; defaults to CPU cores.

workspace.description: Workspace packages to analyze: name or repo-relative path, comma-separated list, globs, `!` negation.

name: list_suppressions
